facts.label: Cost scaling
facts.value: Base cost × 2^(target level − 1), each resource rounded down to whole units.

facts.label: Moon field capacity
facts.value: 1 + 3 × completed Lunar Base level, with no diameter cap. Each building level, including the base itself, occupies one field.

facts.label: Construction
facts.value: An upgrade needs and reserves one free field. Additional capacity becomes available only on completion. Use resources delivered to the moon; moons have no passive resource production.

facts.label: Demolition
facts.value: Lunar Base cannot be demolished. Canceling construction refunds its paid resources without adding capacity.
